discovery.button: Find OpenCCU on the local network
discovery.none: No OpenCCU was found. You can continue using the manual host setting.

settings.title: OpenCCU Local
settings.subtitle: Configure the local OpenCCU connection used for Homematic IP devices.

connection.title: OpenCCU connection
connection.hint: HmIP-RF provides physical devices. VirtualDevices provides OpenCCU heating groups. Enter the host without http:// or a path.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: Create a sanitized support report with connection states, device types, firmware versions and datapoint definitions. Credentials, addresses, OpenCCU names and current values are not included. Please still review the report before sharing it.
diagnostics.ready: The short summary is ready to copy into a forum post or GitHub issue. Select a device model to include its datapoint definitions. The JSON file always contains the complete report.
diagnostics.save: Save or share full JSON file
diagnostics.saved: The download was requested. If no file appears, copy the short summary or open the Homey Web App in a browser to save the JSON file.
diagnostics.save_failed: The file could not be saved from this view. Please copy the report to the clipboard instead.
diagnostics.copied: The short summary was copied to the clipboard.
diagnostics.copy_failed: The report could not be copied automatically. Please select the displayed text and copy it manually.
diagnostics.attach_hint: The Homey Community forum does not accept JSON attachments, and a full report can exceed post limits. Paste the short summary there. For full details, save the JSON file and attach it to a GitHub issue using the file upload button; do not paste the full JSON into the text field.
